models.name: todo_user
models.description:
User accounts for the Todo List Application.

Each record represents a registered individual who can authenticate with the system and manage their own personal todos. Users are identified by a unique email address and secure password hash. All authentication, ownership, and permission enforcement is anchored to this identity. This table supports soft deletion for right-to-be-forgotten compliance, ensuring accounts may be flagged for removal before permanent erasure.

No additional roles, profiles, or social features are present. The model is designed for maximum data privacy, security, and strict one-to-one association with todos. All business rules for user isolation and account uniqueness are enforced here.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for authentication and account recovery. Must be unique across all users and adhere to standard email formatting.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure hash of the user's password. Stored using strong cryptographic practices. Never stores raw passwords.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was created. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the user record, including password or email changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking the account as soft-deleted, used to comply with GDPR and right-to-be-forgotten policies. Null if active.

models.name: todo_user_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for each user account.

Each record logs an authenticated session—such as a login—created by a specific todo_user. Sessions are used to issue JWT tokens and trace account activity for audit and security. The table supports tracking granular user activity over time, including login context. A session is always related to one user, and is never shared.

Includes required context fields for tracing connection origin and temporal window. Soft session expiry is managed via the expired_at field. Sessions are subsidiary—business operations always flow through accounts.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user account. {@link todo_user.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was established, for audit logging.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL at the moment the session was established. Used for security context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL when initiating the session. Provides context for session tracking and security.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time the session was created. Marks session start.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Time when the session expired or was invalidated. Null if session remains active.

models.name: todo_todos
models.description:
Core business entity representing a single todo task owned and managed by a registered user.

Each record is a discrete, user-owned personal task, containing the minimum information required for the application's essential workflow. The table links each task to its owning user, guaranteeing strict single-user isolation and data privacy. Every todo includes a required title, optional description, a boolean state representing completion, and associated timestamps for creation, updates, and completion actions. Titles are unique per user, preventing accidental duplicate todo entries. Updates and state changes are fully captured by timestamps; deletion is permanent, with no soft-delete or archiving—fully aligned to privacy and GDPR requirements. No sharing, group collaboration, or tags/categories are permitted. Ownership, access, and data lifecycle enforcement are managed exclusively through this model's relation to the user table, ensuring all business and security rules are implemented at the persistence level.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each todo item.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user of this todo. Enforces strict single-user data partition and access. {@link todo_user.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short, descriptive title for the todo item. Required on creation; must not be blank or exceed 255 characters. Must be unique for the user. Business rules prohibit empty, duplicate, or whitespace-only values.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed notes or additional context for the todo item. Optional; can be null. Maximum length 1000 characters. Not shown in lists by default.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Boolean status indicating whether the task is complete. Defaults to false on create. Can be toggled by user at any time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the todo was created. Immutable after insertion. Set automatically.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last updated. Modified on every edit or status change.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of completion. Set when a todo is marked as completed, cleared on revert to incomplete. Null if the task is not completed.
